summary: Specifies an experimental SMTP extension for sending and delivering messages that have internationalized email addresses or header information. It updates some syntax and rules in earlier email specifications, and relies on a separate document for communicating with systems that do not support it. It was replaced by RFC 6531.

eli5.summary: This lets the mail trucks carry letters whose addresses are written in any alphabet, not just plain English letters. It was an early trial version, replaced by RFC 6531.
